data.name: Ajmat
data.gender_notes: Ajmat is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ajmat is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'ajas' which means 'invincible' or 'unconquered'. This name signifies strength, power, and courage. In Hindu mythology, Ajmat is the name of a warrior god, symbolizing bravery and fearlessness. The name Ajmat carries the meaning “Strong, Invincible” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ajmat usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, invincible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
